name: Perinton Square
summary: Perinton Square is a recently renovated community shopping center in Fairport, NY, featuring over 40 diverse tenants including popular dining options, fitness centers, and essential services. The center serves as a lifestyle hub for the greater Rochester area with family-friendly businesses and community events.
demographics: Perinton Square serves the affluent suburban community of Fairport, NY, attracting primarily middle to upper-middle income families and professionals from the greater Rochester area. The trade area draws heavily from Perinton and surrounding towns, with shoppers typically ranging from young families to established households seeking convenient access to dining, fitness, and everyday services. The center's tenant mix of family-oriented businesses like The Little Gym, fitness centers, and casual dining options reflects the area's demographic profile of educated, health-conscious residents with disposable income for lifestyle and wellness services.
description: Perinton Square is a vibrant community shopping center located in Fairport, New York, serving the greater Rochester area with a diverse mix of dining, health and beauty, and service-oriented tenants. The center has recently undergone an exciting transformation with enhanced pedestrian access, addition of new tenants, and creation of modern amenities that elevate the shopping experience. With over 40 businesses including popular dining destinations like Chipotle Mexican Grill, Starbucks, and Bocaccinis Italian Bistro & Bar, alongside fitness anchors LA Fitness and Five Step Fitness, Perinton Square has become a lifestyle hub for the community. The center also features essential services including three major banks (KeyBank, Citizens Bank, and Canandaigua National Bank & Trust), specialty retailers, and family-friendly businesses. Beyond shopping, Perinton Square actively engages with the community by hosting events like the annual Fairport K-12 District Art Show and the Holiday Market at the Square, making it more than just a shopping destination but a gathering place for residents of Fairport and surrounding areas.
